projects.ds_aa_som_floods_monitoring.comment: ds-aa-som-floods daily monitoring: Google Flood Hub (source=google, deterministic) and GloFAS operational ensemble (source=glofas; value = ensemble median) at the 7 trigger points. valid_date = calendar day the value describes.

storms.adam_exposure.comment: Population exposure to WFP ADAM cumulative wind footprint, by admin unit. admin_level=0 is country level.

storms.adam_fm_lookup.comment: Static ADAM-admin → FieldMaps-pcode crosswalk. Built offline by scripts/build_adam_fm_lookup.py from the human-reviewed crosswalk; join to storms.adam_exposure on admin_name.

storms.admin_population.comment: Total WorldPop population per FieldMaps admin unit. admin_level=0 is country level. Denominator for exposure tables.

storms.gdacs_exposure.comment: Population exposure to GDACS cumulative wind buffer polygons, by admin unit. admin_level=0 is country level.

storms.gdacs_fm_lookup.comment: Static GDACS-admin → FieldMaps-pcode crosswalk. Built offline by scripts/build_gdacs_fm_lookup.py from the human-reviewed crosswalk; join storms.gdacs_exposure.gdacs_admin_code to gdacs_fm_lookup.gmi_admin.

storms.ibtracs_storms.comment: IBTrACS storm metadata - one row per unique storm identified by sid

storms.ibtracs_tracks_geo.comment: IBTrACS track points with geometry - one row per observation point

storms.ibtracs_wind_buffers.comment: Per-storm wind buffer polygons derived from IBTrACS USA quadrant wind radii

storms.ibtracs_wind_exposure.comment: Population exposure to IBTrACS wind buffer polygons, by admin unit. admin_level=0 is country level.

storms.nhc_storms.comment: NHC storm metadata - one row per unique storm identified by ATCF ID

storms.nhc_tracks_fcast_buffers.comment: Per-forecast wind buffer polygons derived from NHC quadrant wind radii

storms.nhc_tracks_fcast_exposure.comment: Population exposure to NHC forecast wind buffer polygons, by admin unit. admin_level=0 is country level.

storms.nhc_tracks_fcastonly_buffers.comment: Forecast-only wind buffer polygons: forecast buffer minus the cumulative observed track swath at that issued_time

storms.nhc_tracks_geo.comment: NHC track points with geometry - includes observations (leadtime=0) and forecasts (leadtime>0)

storms.nhc_tracks_obsv_buffers.comment: Cumulative observed-track wind buffer polygons: union of all leadtime=0 wind buffers up to each advisory

storms.nhc_wsp_exposure.comment: Population exposure to NHC wind speed probability polygons, by admin unit. admin_level=0 is country level.

storms.nhc_wsp_polygon_raw.comment: NHC basin-wide wind speed probability polygons - one row per issued_time/threshold/probability band

storms.storm_id_lookup.comment: Cross-source storm identifier registry. One row per storm (indexed by gdacs_eventid in the MVP shape).
